|gprice = Not Sold |value = 350 |stats = {{Name|Defense|+1}}{{Name|Immunity|+6}} }} '''Genie Shoes''' are a [[footwear]] item in Stardew Valley. They can be obtained from [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]]. They can be found as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item]] on floors 81-119 of [[The Mines]], in the [[Skull Cavern]], or in the [[Quarry Mine]] by killing [[The Mines#Special Items|special monsters]] or by breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]].
